'''Usatsuhiko no Mikoto''' (菟狭津彦命, [[生没年不詳]]) was an ancient Japanese noble and the first {{ill|Usa Kuni no miyatsuko|ja|宇佐国造}}.

== Overview ==
In the {{ill|Kojiki|en|Kojiki|qid=Q813031|lt=Kojiki}}, he is referred to as '''Usatsuhiko''' (宇沙都比古), in the {{ill|Nihon Shoki|en|Nihon Shoki|qid=Q813935|lt=Nihon Shoki}} and {{ill|Kōsonki|ja|皇孫本紀}} as '''Usatsuhiko''' (菟狭津彦), and in the {{ill|Kujiki|ja|国造本紀|lt=Kuni no miyatsuko honki}} as '''Usatsuhiko no Mikoto''' (宇佐都彦命).

The {{ill|Kojiki|en|Kojiki|qid=Q813031|lt=Kojiki}} describes him as residing in Usa in Toyokuni (豊国), while the {{ill|Nihon Shoki|en|Nihon Shoki|qid=Q813935|lt=Nihon Shoki}} places him in Usa in Tsukushi (筑紫国), appearing alongside his sister {{ill|Usatsuhime no Mikoto|ja|菟狭津媛}}.

According to the {{ill|Nihon Shoki|en|Nihon Shoki|qid=Q813935|lt=Nihon Shoki}}, during the {{ill|Jimmu's Eastern Expedition|en|Jimmu's Eastern Expedition|qid=Q11590444|lt=Jimmu tosei}}, Emperor Jimmu, aiming for Nakasu (present-day Yamato Province), landed in Usa, Tsukushi. There he encountered Usatsuhiko and Usatsuhime, ancestors of the {{ill|Usa Kuni no miyatsuko|ja|宇佐国造}} clan. They built a palace called Hitotsuhashi no Miya (一柱騰宮) on the upper reaches of the Usa River and hosted Emperor Jimmu. The emperor decreed that Usatsuhime be married to {{ill|Amenotaneko|ja|天種子命|lt=Ametaneko no Mikoto}}, the ancestor of the {{ill|Nakatomi clan|en|Nakatomi clan|qid=Q1198447|lt=Nakatomi clan}}. While similar traditions are recorded in the {{ill|Kujiki|en|Kujiki|qid=Q2716751|lt=Sendai Kuji Hongi}} and {{ill|Kojiki|en|Kojiki|qid=Q813031|lt=Kojiki}}, the {{ill|Kojiki|en|Kojiki|qid=Q813031|lt=Kojiki}} omits any mention of {{ill|Amenotaneko|ja|天種子命|lt=Ametaneko no Mikoto}}.

{{quote|Usa District
Usatsuhiko no Mikoto (loyalty, reverence to gods, moral principles)

A child of {{ill|Takamimusubi|qid=Q125400|lt=Takamimusubi|lt=Takami Musubi no Mikoto|ja|高皇産霊尊|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Takami Musubi no Mikoto|qid=Q125400}}’s grandson {{ill|Amenokushimori no Mikoto|ja|天三降命}}, he resided on Usa Island. Serving the goddess {{ill|Himegami|ja|比売大神|lt=Hime-no-Ōkami}}, he hosted Emperor Jimmu during his eastern expedition and built Hitotsuhashi no Miya to provide for him. He is regarded as the ancestor of the {{ill|Usa clan|ja|宇佐氏}}, whose descendants include notable families like the Miyase and Itozu baronial families.|{{Cite book|title=修身科郷土資料集成|author=大分県教育会|year=1936}}}}

== Genealogy ==
{{see|Usa clan}}
He is considered a child of {{ill|Amenokushimori no Mikoto|ja|天三降命}}, a descendant of {{ill|Takamimusubi|qid=Q125400|lt=Takamimusubi|lt=Takami Musubi no Mikoto|ja|高皇産霊尊|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Takami Musubi no Mikoto|qid=Q125400}}. He was a member of the {{ill|Usa clan|ja|宇佐氏}}.

His sister, {{ill|Usatsuhime no Mikoto|ja|菟狭津媛}}, became the wife of {{ill|Amenotaneko|ja|天種子命|lt=Ametaneko no Mikoto}} and the mother of {{ill|Usatsumi no Mikoto|ja|宇佐津臣命}}, the ancestor of the {{ill|Nakatomi clan|en|Nakatomi clan|qid=Q1198447|lt=Nakatomi clan}}.
